aiOverview.content: Fairleigh Dickinson University (FDU) is New Jersey's largest private university, known for its global focus, small class sizes, and career-oriented programs across two NJ campuses, a Vancouver campus, and Wroxton College in England. Offering over 100 degrees, it has an acceptance rate around 84–90% and a 2023-2024 tuition of $35,822. Key Highlights & Academics Campuses: Florham Campus (Madison, NJ), Metropolitan Campus (Teaneck, NJ), Vancouver (Canada), and Wroxton (England). Academics: Offers programs from associate to PhD levels, including strong, AACSB-accredited business school, nursing, psychology, and criminal justice programs. Distinction: FDU has a strong focus on global education and is an Age-Friendly University member. Athletics: The FDU Knights compete in NCAA Division I, with notable recent participation in the NCAA women's basketball tournament. Admissions and Cost Acceptance Rate: The University is lightly selective, with acceptance rates often reported around 84% for the Florham Campus and up to 90% in other metrics. Tuition: For the 2023–2024 academic year, tuition was approximately $35,822, though overall costs vary by campus and program. Reputation and Popular Majors FDU is recognized for its programs in business, health sciences, engineering, and liberal arts. It is known for preparing students for the global marketplace. Notable Aspects Largest Gift: FDU recently received the largest gift in its history to support the College of Psychology and Counseling. Diverse Community: Hosts over 12,000 students across its campuses and online programs.
